task.description: ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis (step-01-issue-fixer.json result.summary, read in full): DropLegacyPublicIdentityTables's guard DO $$ block (priv/repo/migrations/20260819000004_drop_legacy_public_identity_tables.exs) loops every row of public.tenant_schemas and, for each, runs three dynamic EXECUTE format('... FROM %I.groups ...'/'%I.users'/'%I.tenant_role' ...) queries. Postgres must resolve %I.<table> as a real relation to even plan the dynamically-built statement, regardless of whether the outer WHERE clause would have matched zero rows -- so ANY tenant_schemas row whose schema is missing one of these three tables (e.g. a tenant provisioned via TenantProvisioning.provision_tenant_schema/1 but never/not-yet migrated via replay_migrations/2 -- confirmed live in the test DB as a leaked row from an interrupted :auto-mode test fixture, same leak class as ISS-0048) makes the guard crash with 42P01 undefined_table instead of treating that tenant as 'not yet copied' and skipping the DROP safely. This is a genuine robustness gap in the guard's own logic, not just a test-fixture-hygiene problem (ISS-0048's fix, separately, should reduce how often leaked rows exist -- but even a legitimate tenant mid-provisioning in a real deployment could hit this same crash, so the guard itself needs to tolerate a missing table rather than assume every registered tenant_schemas row already has these three tables).
acceptance_criteria: Design a fix to the guard DO $$ block so that a tenant_schemas row whose schema is missing groups/users/tenant_role is treated as 'copy not complete for this tenant' (v_all_copied := FALSE, skip the DROP, RAISE NOTICE identifying the tenant/missing table) rather than raising an uncaught 42P01 error.

The fix must use a check that resolves safely regardless of table existence before referencing %I.<table> in a query Postgres has to plan (e.g. to_regclass(format('%I.<table>', schema_name)) IS NULL as a guard before the EXECUTE, or equivalent) -- state the exact mechanism, this is SQL/plpgsql design, not application code, so the design artifact should specify the modified DO $$ block's logic precisely (pseudocode/structure, not necessarily runnable SQL verbatim, per CODE-DESIGNER's normal design-not-implementation scope, but precise enough ELIXIR-DEV does not have to invent the check).
Preserve all existing guard behavior for the already-covered case (a tenant whose tables exist but rows are missing/not copied) -- do not weaken that check.
Preserve the migration's existing idempotency (re-run after a successful drop must still no-op via the to_regclass('public.users') IS NULL check at the top, unchanged).
State explicitly that this is a migration-file (SQL/plpgsql-in-Elixir) change, not a schema/module design -- no Ecto schema or module @spec changes are needed for this fix.

Do not attempt to fix ISS-0048 (orphaned schema accumulation) itself in this design -- that stays open as its own separate issue; this fix only makes the guard tolerate the leaked-row case it already needs to tolerate for legitimate mid-provisioning tenants too.

result.summary: Design written to lib/letflow/design/iss-0050-drop-legacy-guard-missing-table.md. Fix is confined entirely to the DO $$ block inside priv/repo/migrations/20260819000004_drop_legacy_public_identity_tables.exs's `up/0` -- no Ecto schema or module @spec changes needed. Mechanism: before each of the three existing per-table dynamic EXECUTE checks (groups/users/tenant_role) inside the `FOR v_tenant IN SELECT tenant_id, schema_name FROM public.tenant_schemas LOOP`, add `IF to_regclass(format('%I.<table>', v_tenant.schema_name)) IS NULL THEN v_all_copied := FALSE; RAISE NOTICE (naming tenant_id, schema_name, and the missing table); ELSE <existing EXECUTE format(...) INTO v_missing_count + IF v_missing_count > 0 ... END IF block, byte-for-byte unchanged> END IF;` -- reusing the same to_regclass(...) IS NULL builtin the guard's own top-of-block idempotency check (lines 78-83) already uses, so no new mechanism is introduced. Folds a missing table into the existing v_all_copied := FALSE / skip-the-DROP path (unchanged, lines 130-133) rather than a new terminal state, preserving the guard's skip-on-doubt philosophy. IF/ELSE (not CONTINUE) used so a tenant missing only one of the three tables still gets its other two tables checked independently. Top-of-block idempotency short-circuit (to_regclass('public.users') IS NULL AND ... RETURN) is untouched and still runs strictly before the loop. Does not fix ISS-0048 (orphaned schema accumulation, stays open separately); flags as an operational note (design section 7) that the currently-leaked tenant_schemas row in the shared letflow_test DB should still be verified/purged as part of landing this fix per ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis, but the code fix itself makes the guard tolerate that row rather than requiring its removal.
